exactBoundary: Tailwind CSS v4 automatic source discovery inside @tailwindcss/postcss, invoked for app/globals.css

mechanism.explanation: @import tailwindcss enabled automatic project-root discovery. The three @source directives added roots but did not disable that automatic **/* root. Tailwind Oxide therefore performed a pathological repository-wide glob walk before it could scan the intended application files.

evidence.postcssWorkerState: alive until parent IPC deadline; sampled in Tailwind Scanner::get_globs and filesystem is_file

whyRepeated: Every normal build compiled the same globals.css import, reconstructed the same automatic project-root **/* source, and entered the same Tailwind filesystem discovery path until Turbopack's PostCSS IPC deadline elapsed.
resourcePressureRole: consequence of excessive input discovery; not the initiating defect
nextTurbopackRole: reported the downstream IPC timeout after the PostCSS worker failed to return; not the initiating defect
minimumRepair: Change the Tailwind import to source(none) and retain the existing explicit app/components/src @source directives.

postFixValidation.termination: Deliberate SIGTERM after the build remained in Creating an optimized production build with severe memory/swap pressure and no output progress.
postFixValidation.postcssBoundaryStatus: The repaired PostCSS worker returned quickly and was idle; process samples contained no Tailwind Scanner/get_globs frames.
postFixValidation.remainingBoundary: A distinct later Turbopack graph/build resource stall remains. Its initiating file or package is not yet proven, so no speculative third build was run.
